skill.name: lumorig
skill.description: Create, rebuild, animate, and ship brand mascots with Lumorig — generate a new rigged vector mascot from a description or rebuild an existing mascot image, add animations (instant presets or described motion), and export Lottie/SVG/GIF/MP4/stickers or a live <lumorig-player> embed. Use when the user wants a mascot, character, animated brand avatar, chatbot avatar, empty-state illustration, or loading/celebration animation for their app or site.

content.user_title: Create and Animate Brand Mascots with Lumorig
content.value_statement: Brand teams need consistent mascot artwork across animations, product interfaces, and downloadable assets. This skill guides Lumorig creation, image rebuilding, animation, and export through available service interfaces.
actual_capabilities: Guide mascot creation from descriptions or existing images, with style selection and fidelity review.
Apply animation presets or request described motion with adjustable intensity.
Export Lottie, animated SVG, video, stickers, logos, and still images through Lumorig.
Integrate the Lumorig web player and template-based chatbot, agent, or onboarding states.
Recolor palette tokens, preserve alternate looks as variants, and show or hide props.
limitations: Requires access to Lumorig through available MCP tools, the CLI, or the authenticated REST API; no local generation engine is included.
Generation takes approximately one to four minutes and uses credits; download costs, watermarks, and resolution depend on the plan.
Image rebuilding can require fidelity review before further animation or export.
Private embeds use expiring signed links; permanent public embeds change asset visibility, and the hosted player introduces a remote script dependency.

use_cases.title: Build a Brand Mascot
use_cases.description: Create a rigged mascot from a brand description, review its style, and export consistent artwork for product surfaces.

use_cases.title: Connect a Chatbot Avatar
use_cases.description: Use a chatbot canvas template to connect listening, thinking, and talking states to an embedded mascot.

use_cases.title: Prepare Seasonal Variants
use_cases.description: Create alternate mascot outfits, toggle props, and export campaign animations while preserving the current look.

prompt_templates.title: Create a First Mascot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a friendly robot mascot for my budgeting app in the flat style. Use teal and coral with a small antenna. Show the preview.

prompt_templates.title: Rebuild Existing Artwork
prompt_templates.prompt: Rebuild my supplied mascot image as a rigged vector character. Report the fidelity result. If review is needed, show a side-by-side before continuing.

prompt_templates.title: Animate and Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply wave and celebrate presets to my selected mascot at intensity 1. Export Lottie after confirming any download charge with me.

prompt_templates.title: Integrate Interactive States
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a chatbot canvas for my existing mascot with listening, thinking, and talking states. Keep the asset private. Confirm signed-link renewal and player-loading requirements before implementation.

output_examples.input: Recommend a delivery format for a vector mascot animation on my website.
output_examples.output: Lottie is the documented compact vector option. Animated SVG is another option when you need an animation without JavaScript.

output_examples.input: I need a seasonal outfit without replacing my current mascot look.
output_examples.output: Create a named variant to preserve the current look. Existing animations remain available, and you can switch looks later.

output_examples.input: Can my private mascot use a permanent embed link?
output_examples.output: Private embeds use expiring signed links. The documented permanent option requires public visibility, so confirm disclosure is acceptable before changing access.

best_practices: Specify personality, brand colors, style, and one or two signature details before generating a mascot.
Review image fidelity when requested, and use palette recoloring or named variants for focused changes.
Confirm charges, asset visibility, and hosted script requirements before exporting or integrating an embed.
anti_patterns: Using AI edits for simple palette changes instead of the documented recoloring operation.
Replacing the current look when a named seasonal variant would preserve it.
Making a private mascot public solely for a permanent embed without confirming disclosure is acceptable.

faq.question: Which interfaces can this skill use?
faq.answer: It documents Lumorig MCP tools, the CLI, and the REST API. The REST API uses a bearer API key.

faq.question: Can I start from an existing mascot image?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply a file or URL, then review the fidelity result and any requested side-by-side comparison before proceeding.

faq.question: Which animation options are documented?
faq.answer: The skill lists presets such as wave, celebrate, and think. It also supports requests described as motion.

faq.question: Which export formats are available?
faq.answer: Documented formats include Lottie, animated SVG, WebM, MP4, GIF, stickers, vector logos, PNG, and SVG stills.

faq.question: Does generation or downloading cost credits?
faq.answer: Generation uses credits. Presets and recolors are free. Downloads are free on Maker and Studio; Free requires a 50-credit unlock per character.

faq.question: Can I embed a private mascot permanently?
faq.answer: Private mascots use expiring signed links. The documented permanent embed option requires making the mascot public.
